player_intent: Training Mode keeps a fast B-key free-loadout menu without restoring purchases or buy phases to multiplayer.
acceptance_rule: In res://main.tscn with Public Training active, B opens and closes the free-loadout menu while the player is inside the equipment zone. Outside Public Training the training action is absent, the local menu does not consume input, and multiplayer B remains fire-mode control.

nodes.role: Owns the Training-only free-loadout presentation and consumes its context-specific B action before the gameplay HUD can toggle fire mode.

must_not_change: multiplayer random round weapon assignment and absence of purchase RPCs
B fire-mode control outside the Training equipment-zone context
server shot, damage, ammunition, and networking authority
camera, reticle, animation, IK, and weapon-contact ownership
visual_check: Launch Training Range, remain near its spawn equipment zone, press B, select a free firearm, and confirm the menu closes with the selected weapon equipped. Press B twice to confirm deterministic open and close. Join a tournament and confirm B changes fire mode without opening a store.

system_delta.reason: The local Training free-issue menu and authorized pickup path already exist. Restore only their context-gated input while leaving the removed multiplayer economy and purchase path removed.

current.system: Retained Training menu with an inert input adapter

candidate.system: Training-only B input routed through the existing free-loadout owner
